description: Hand-curated competency mapping for NYSC COURSE-041 Preschool Teacher (Early Childhood Development) against its three linked early childhood records. A DOCUMENTED cell cites the exact stored text that names the competency. NOT_EXPLICIT means the available description does not name it, not that it is absent from teaching. INSUFFICIENT_DATA means the stored text is unavailable, outside the record's scope, or too ambiguous to assess.
method: The NYSC column was assessed by hand against this course's four governed headings. Heading 1 ('Handling skills and design') is too unspecific to establish any competency and is not cited. Heading 2 is cited by its governed text with the verified display correction. Coverage is never inferred from programme titles, qualification levels or unstored text.

ecd_environment_exploration: exploring the natural or wider environment with children
ecd_learning_methods: planning or organising learning activities using appropriate methods
ecd_language_literacy: developing children's language or early literacy skills
ecd_creative_arts: developing children's aesthetic, art or music skills
ecd_inclusion: including children with diverse or special needs

methodology.DOCUMENTED: The cited stored text explicitly names the competency. Coverage records whether it names every component of the category (FULL) or only some (PARTIAL).
methodology.FULL: The cited evidence supports the competency as labelled: every listed component of the category is explicitly named.
methodology.PARTIAL: Only a component of the category, or a lower level of activity, is explicitly documented; supported_component records what is supported.
methodology.NOT_EXPLICIT: The competency is not documented within the available, assessed scope of the source (units, modules, learning outcomes or verified scope passages as stored).
methodology.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Missing or incomplete material prevents a reliable assessment.
methodology.caution: None of these statuses proves that a competency is or is not actually taught.
methodology.areas_rule: Areas to Investigate list competencies that the NYSC description does not name (NOT_EXPLICIT) and that at least two distinct comparator records, from at least two different countries, document with FULL coverage. PARTIAL evidence is shown but not counted.
decisions: Only early childhood records are linked; the Sri Lankan standard is the renamed successor of the 'Preschool Teacher (Early Childhood Development)' standard.
Australian cells assess the 15 core units only; electives are not stored.
